scope: Production Three.js scene-graph properties with a stub canvas; no actual rasterization, browser, physical collision or VLM inference.

checks.name: Three numbered signs are initially visible in a new trail
Active and future signs use compact global scales without changing floor goals
After first goal, only its sign and stem retire; the green floor ring remains
After second goal, the third sign remains visible
Completed course retains all floor rings and no occluding billboards
Starting another round restores every numbered sign and stem
Leaving the trail hides its complete scene group
